baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 together with the distancing complement that terminates in the saying at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purification and disavowal operate on attributed speech: the clause does not merely praise after a claim but actively clears the divine referent of the claim's content.

activation_trace.role: Purifying disavowal supplies the clearing act and makes separation from the attribution functional.
Speech falsely assigned to another supplies the kind of attribution from which the divine referent is cleared.

changed_reading.before: A praise formula appended after an objectionable statement.
changed_reading.after: A performative removal of the divine referent from the content speakers attach to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two ع ل و occurrences at focus words 2 and 5, with the magnitude qualifier at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A verbal rise is restated as a nominal measure and then enlarged. Elevation is therefore both a condition and an unbounded scale, not a single location.

activation_trace.role: Rising supplies the vertical vector carried by both occurrences.
Exalted rank converts the vertical vector into non-spatial dignity and status.
Magnitude supplies the scale that prevents the elevation from being read as a small local difference.

changed_reading.before: God is very high above the statement.
changed_reading.after: The statement is exceeded by an elevation expressed as both event and measure, with no commensurate upper bound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ق و ل predicate at focus word 4 under the broad relative complement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying can range from voiced words to an adopted doctrine and a claim about what reality signifies. The rejection can therefore reach the speakers' interpretive model, not only their sentence.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance supplies the immediate surface of the rejected saying.
Adopted belief extends the object of rejection from wording to the position held through that wording.
Signification extends the saying to the world-model the speakers claim their words disclose.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects a spoken sentence.
changed_reading.after: The verse exceeds the speakers' whole doctrinal and signifying model, including the sentence that voices it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ع ل و pair at focus words 2 and 5 joined to the ك ب ر qualifier at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of prevailing and overcoming make the elevation dynamic: the rejected claim is not merely below but unable to rival or contain divine sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing over another supplies the sovereign asymmetry encoded by the elevation.
Overcoming a contender sharpens the magnitude into failed rivalry rather than static size.

changed_reading.before: A static difference in height or dignity.
changed_reading.after: A sovereign asymmetry in which the attribution cannot compete with, contain, or master its referent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding claim allocates filial categories and is itself magnified; the focus then places great magnitude on divine elevation. This reassigns greatness from the audacity of the proposition to the distance between that proposition and its referent.

activation_trace.role: Magnitude in the focus supplies the scale onto which the preceding claim's enormity is redirected.
Preferential selection supplies the allocating act presupposed by the rejected claim.
Filial lineage supplies the kinship category projected onto divine order.
Greatness and force mark the speakers' proposition as enormous and set up the focus's reversal of magnitude.

structural_cues: 17:40 ends with a saying plus a magnitude adjective; 17:43 repeats the saying frame and ends with elevation plus a magnitude adjective.
The focus follows the kinship allocation without changing the speaking group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, lineage, and parallel magnitude closures; I infer a rhetorical transfer of greatness from the claim's enormity to divine elevation. A live alternative is that the two magnitude adjectives intensify separate clauses without deliberate transfer.

changed_reading.before: Great elevation is an isolated intensifier.
changed_reading.after: Great elevation answers a supposedly great claim by relocating magnitude from human attribution to the unbridgeable divine difference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual gives alleged peers a route-seeking relation to an elevated royal center. The focus then denies that divine elevation is one coordinate among others: any supposed peers would already be subordinate seekers.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign prevailing supplies the rank that turns all proposed peers into subordinates.
Objects of worship supply the hypothetical plurality whose status is being tested.
Seeking supplies the directed dependence of the hypothetical rivals.
An elevated royal seat supplies the sovereign destination toward which the seekers are oriented.
A traversable way supplies the route that alleged peers would need but does not place them at the destination.

structural_cues: 17:42 is a conditional reductio whose consequence assigns movement toward a single throne-holder.
17:43 follows with doubled elevation and no route language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plurality, seeking, a royal destination, and a path; I infer that needing a route establishes subordination and makes the focus's height a rank rather than a coordinate. A live alternative is that 17:42 only refutes plurality and leaves the spatial coloring untouched.

changed_reading.before: The divine is located higher than the alleged peers.
changed_reading.after: Divine elevation is singular sovereign rank; alleged peers cannot share its plane because the counterfactual makes them route-seeking dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The compact purification at the focus unfolds immediately into repeated, universal activity joined to praise, while human hearers fail to comprehend it. The focus is therefore a local articulation of a reality-wide act, not merely a corrective interjection.

activation_trace.role: Purifying disavowal supplies the focus's compact act of clearing.
Worship through repeated glorification expands the focus act into the activity of the whole created field.
Praise opposed to blame supplies the affirmative accompaniment to purification.
Understanding supplies the missing human capacity, making cosmic glorification real even when its mode is inaccessible.

structural_cues: 17:44 repeats the focus root three times and distributes its action across heavens, earth, inhabitants, and every thing.
The non-comprehension clause contrasts universal performance with limited human uptake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition, universal subjects, praise, and failed understanding; I infer that 17:43 voices one local instance of an ongoing cosmic act. A live alternative is that 17:44 merely supplies a fresh example after a completed refutation.

changed_reading.before: A human speaker inserts a formula that corrects other humans.
changed_reading.after: The human formula joins a universal glorifying activity whose full mode outruns the very speakers being corrected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from a separating screen and weighted hearing to listening, analogy production, and loss of a way. This makes the rejected saying the output of a damaged interpretive pipeline: inaccessible reception is converted into fabricated likenesses.

activation_trace.role: Speech as signification anchors the contextual sequence to the world-model expressed by the speakers.
A screening barrier supplies the first break between recited discourse and reception.
Auditory weight supplies impaired uptake rather than lack of emitted discourse.
Hearing as understanding and compliance marks the deeper faculty that surface listening fails to realize.
Producing and displaying an analogy supplies the speakers' compensating interpretive act.
Likeness supplies the category error through which the inaccessible referent is forced into comparison.
Departure from a guiding aim supplies the result of the analogy-making sequence.

structural_cues: 17:45-48 forms an ordered sequence of barrier, impaired understanding, observed listening, private speech, analogies, and no available way.
The speakers remain verbally active even as receptive access deteriorates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered reception failures, analogy-making, and lost way; I infer a causal pipeline in which blocked uptake yields misdescription. A live alternative is that these are parallel symptoms of rejection rather than consecutive causes.

changed_reading.before: The speakers possess a wrong proposition that the focus rejects.
changed_reading.after: Their proposition is generated by failed reception: what they cannot understand they replace with likenesses, and the focus clears God of that manufactured model.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge escalates imagined resistance from fragments to stone, iron, and whatever feels still greater, then answers with first origination. The focus's great elevation can thus exceed not only a statement but the speakers' material and temporal limits on possibility.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing supplies the capacity to exceed the resistant categories proposed by the speakers.
Pulverized remains supply the speakers' first material limit on renewed creation.
Hard stone escalates the imagined resistance beyond fragile remains.
Iron-like hardness supplies a second escalation of material resistance.
What becomes mentally heavy or difficult supplies the subjective ceiling of the challenge.
Origination supplies the causal answer that bypasses the proposed material limits.
Priority and beginning supply the temporal precedent for renewed creation.

structural_cues: 17:49-51 escalates a question through progressively resistant materials before returning to first origination.
17:52 collapses the expected duration when the called subjects respond.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material escalation, subjective heaviness, and first origination; I infer that divine elevation marks causal superiority over their possibility categories. A live alternative is that the resurrection exchange is independent of the focus's vertical language.

changed_reading.before: The focus exceeds only a theological attribution.
changed_reading.after: The focus also prefigures divine superiority over the material hardness and temporal irreversibility that structure the speakers' disbelief.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command for better saying is paired with hostile verbal incitement. The focus does not condemn speech as such; it distinguishes attributed speech that diminishes its referent from speech disciplined toward what is better.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech anchors both the rejected attribution and the later commanded alternative.
Repeated utterance supplies the channel whose content and direction can be ethically changed.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the criterion for repairing speech.
Distance and severance supply the hostile force that speech can introduce between people.
A verbal stab supplies the concrete mechanism by which speech becomes divisive.
Enmity supplies the social relation produced by the corrupting speech channel.

structural_cues: 17:53 repeats the focus speech root in an imperative and in the commanded response.
The verse places better speech and interpersonal incitement in direct opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commanded speech alternative, verbal incitement, and enmity; I infer that 17:43 rejects a corrupt use of speech rather than language itself. A live alternative is that 17:53 starts a separate ethical instruction with no backward qualification.

changed_reading.before: Human saying stands generically opposed to divine transcendence.
changed_reading.after: Speech is a contested channel: one use projects diminishing claims, while another can be disciplined toward goodness and restored relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The allegedly independent beings cannot remove or transfer harm and are then recast as seekers of nearness, mercy, and safety. The focus's elevation names a dependency gradient: proposed peers turn out to be petitioners within the same order.

activation_trace.role: Exalted rank supplies the upper term of the dependency gradient.
Assertion without certainty marks the alleged independence as a speaker-produced claim.
Otherness supplies the proposed alternatives whose actual status the next verse reverses.
Seeking supplies dependence by making the invoked beings pursuers rather than endpoints.
Approach toward God supplies the direction and goal of the invoked beings' own striving.
Merciful tenderness supplies what the alleged alternatives themselves hope to receive.
Anticipatory fear supplies their vulnerability to the authority above them.

structural_cues: The objects invoked in 17:56 become the seeking subjects in 17:57.
Inability to alter harm is followed by hope and fear directed toward their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertain claims, inability, subject reversal, seeking, hope, and fear; I infer a dependency gradient that explicates elevation as rank. A live alternative is that these verses refute intercession without specifying the semantics of elevation.

changed_reading.before: God is one high being contrasted with other beings.
changed_reading.after: The contrast is categorical dependence: every proposed peer is itself a seeker, recipient, and vulnerable subject under divine rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context combines the Lord's encompassing relation to people with a shown vision that functions as a test. This prevents vertical transcendence from becoming spatial absence: the elevated referent still encloses, discloses, and tests the lower field.

activation_trace.role: The upper direction supplies the spatial reading that the context must qualify.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies presence and control across the human field.
Causing something to be seen supplies disclosure from the encompassing authority into human perception.
Testing supplies an active relation that sorts human response rather than withdrawing from it.

structural_cues: 17:60 predicates encompassing of people before describing a disclosed vision as a test for those people.
The same context contains divine speech, showing, warning, and measured human response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encompassing, disclosed vision, and testing; I infer that elevation and intimate governance coexist, so above does not mean absent. A live alternative is that encompassing is only epistemic and does not intentionally qualify the earlier vertical expression.

changed_reading.before: Transcendence suggests remote distance from the human field.
changed_reading.after: Transcendence is non-containment by human claims while divine knowledge and governance still encompass the claimants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's split mapping from the focus speech root to a form-distant carrying branch, so it is surprising and must not replace the ordinary speech reading. It remains anchored at focus word 4 and coheres with the focus's ascent and heaviness branches; downstream prose should label it an exploratory wordplay in which attribution becomes a load, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 4 read through its non-dominant mapped inventory alongside the elevation pair and magnitude qualifier.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and rising recast the attributed saying as a load hoisted by its speakers.
True ascent supplies the contrasting movement that exceeds the speakers' attempted lifting.
Heaviness supplies the burden-like quality of the claim and the difficulty of sustaining it.

changed_reading.before: The speakers state a large false claim.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they try to lift and carry a heavy attribution, while divine ascent exceeds both the load and their act of raising it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This transfers a water-rise image from the context's transgression root into the focus's vertical field, so the cross-domain mechanism is intentionally odd. It remains anchored by the focus elevation pair and the repeated magnitude root at 17:60; downstream prose should present human overflow as a possible counterfeit ascent, not as the primary meaning of either root.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus elevation pair and magnitude qualifier set against the context's final transgression and repeated magnitude.

activation_trace.role: Elevation supplies the true upward axis against which the context's excess can be compared.
Flood-like rising and sweeping force turn transgression into a mimetic but destructive ascent.
Repeated magnitude links the context's expanding transgression to the focus's great elevation while preserving their opposition.

changed_reading.before: Divine elevation and human transgression occupy unrelated images.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, human transgression swells upward like a flood, a counterfeit elevation whose force remains categorically unlike divine transcendence.

strongest_changes: The 17:42 conditional turns elevation from traversable height into singular sovereign rank.
The 17:44 repetition expands the focus purification into a universal act whose mode exceeds human comprehension.
The 17:45-48 sequence recasts the rejected saying as the output of blocked reception and misplaced analogy.
The 17:56-57 subject reversal makes alleged peers into seekers and exposes elevation as a dependency gradient.
The encompassing relation in 17:60 prevents transcendence from being reduced to remoteness.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses purification, doubled elevation, speech, and magnitude into one line; the context repeatedly unfolds those elements as kinship correction, sovereign hierarchy, cosmic activity, failed interpretation, ethical speech, dependence, and encompassing governance without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The magnitude reversal with 17:40 is structurally strong but may be parallel intensification rather than deliberate reassignment.
The barrier-to-analogy sequence may be causal or may collect independent symptoms of rejection.
The load-bearing split mapping and flood-ascent model are valid only as explicitly contained exploratory activations.
